text:
sam: Heads-up: scheduling tenant_profiles schema change in the Wed maintenance window 03:00-03:30 UTC. Plan: add is_premium bool (nullable), backfill based on billing table, then FK validate. Requesting deploybot holdpoint before backfill and service version pin to v2.14.1 for the backfill period. Rollback criteria proposal: >1% 5xx or replication lag >30s for >5m.

deploybot: holdpoint created at 03:05 UTC. It will block the migration apply step until a +ack from eng leads. I will auto-release if canary passes or on manual release by @sam/@ashley. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/migrations/tenant_profiles

ashley: +1 on pinning to v2.14.1. Also request we set max_concurrent_backfills=4 to avoid hotspotting — saw node OOM last time with 8.

vikram: suggestion: create a temporary index on billing(user_id, tier) before the backfill to avoid a full seqscan. I'll include that index in a separate preflight deployment and canary it at 2% traffic. Plan to canary the backfill on 5% of tenants for 10m.

maria: drafting release notes now — short blurb: "tenant_profiles: add is_premium flag; backfill sets flag for customers with active billing tier >=pro". Will post in #release-notes after final signoff.

sam: quick preflight checklist:
- verify schema migration SQL + index change in staging
- schedule deploybot holdpoint at pre-backfill (done)
- pin service to v2.14.1 at 03:00-05:00 UTC
- apply index in preflight window 02:50-03:00 UTC
- run backfill at holdpoint 03:10 UTC on canary subset then scale
- monitor p95 latency, 5xx, and replication lag; abort if triggers

opsbot: monitoring: set temporary alert "migration-high-latency" if p95 > 300ms for web tier or replication lag > 25s. Watch queries:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_profiles WHERE is_premium IS NULL;
SELECT count(*) FROM billing WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM tenant_profiles WHERE is_premium IS NULL);
```

ashley: if we hit the rollback criteria, our mitigation is: hold DDL (stop further rows), revert service changes that depend on new column, run targeted rollback queries for partial writes if needed. Note: full DDL rollback isn't possible; plan for forward-safe fallback.

vikram: also adding a temporary feature flag to short-circuit reads to old column for 30m if we detect issues. Will push flag gate in same deploy as the canary.

deploybot: canary deploy started at 03:06 UTC for 5% traffic. Holdpoint reached at 03:09 UTC awaiting manual release to run full backfill.

sam: manual +ack from me at 03:10 UTC to proceed with canary backfill.

deploybot: backfill started at 03:11 UTC on 5% subset. Canary window 10m.

opsbot: alert check at 03:17 UTC: p95 web 220ms, 5xx 0.08%, replication lag 6s — within thresholds.

maria: canary looks good, metrics look stable. Posting release note draft in #release-notes now.

deploybot: holdpoint released at 03:22 UTC to scale backfill to full set per plan. Will keep version pin until 05:00 UTC.

ashley: monitoring during scale looks clean. Will keep an eye on disk I/O on db-shard-3.

sam: final: if no regressions by 04:30 UTC we unpin v2.14.1 and mark migration complete. If any critical regressions before then we follow rollback criteria and escalate to oncall-db.

ashley: confirmed we unpinned at 05:15 UTC after extended checks. All good. :tada:
